A grove of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the zenith of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and meadow-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
